XECH-Solaris Wall cum Table Clock – Smart Digital LED Clock for Modern Spaces

Upgrade your interiors with the XECH-Solaris Wall cum Table Clock, a stylish and multifunctional Digital LED Wall cum Table Clock designed for modern homes, offices, and commercial spaces. Combining advanced digital display technology with elegant aesthetics, this clock delivers accurate timekeeping, calendar details, temperature readings, and day-of-week information in one sleek unit.

Available in premium models such as Moon, Earth, Mars, Archer, Kitty, and customizable designs, the XECH-Solaris clock blends décor appeal with everyday functionality. Whether mounted on a wall or placed on a desk, it enhances visibility while saving space.

Key Features

  • Dual-use design – can be used as a wall clock or table clock
  • Bright, clear digital LED display for easy readability
  • Displays digital clock, calendar (MM/DD), day of week, and temperature
  • Temperature display supports both C° and F°
  • USB-powered for consistent performance and energy efficiency
  • Comes with a 1.5 meter USB cable for flexible placement
  • Inline controls for easy setup and adjustment
  • Multiple modern and playful design models available

Advanced Digital Display with Everyday Utility

The from the Solaris range offers a high-contrast LED display that remains clearly visible during both day and night. Designed for quick information access, the display simultaneously shows time, date, day, and temperature—making it ideal for busy professionals, students, and families. The built-in calendar follows the MM/DD format, while the temperature sensor provides accurate readings in Celsius and Fahrenheit. This makes the clock suitable for global users and various environments including bedrooms, living rooms, offices, reception areas, cafés, and retail stores.

Stylish Models to Match Every Interior

XECH-Solaris clocks are available in unique and eye-catching models such as Moon, Earth, Mars for a futuristic look, while Archer and Kitty designs add a fun and creative touch. Customizable options are also available for branding, gifting, or personalized décor needs. These design-focused digital clocks not only tell time but also act as decorative statement pieces, complementing modern, minimalist, or themed interiors effortlessly.

USB Powered with Easy Inline Controls

The is powered via USB, ensuring stable operation without frequent battery replacements. The included 1.5 meter cable allows flexible installation near power sources. Inline control buttons make setting the time, date, and display preferences simple and intuitive, even for first-time users. This user-friendly design ensures quick setup with minimal effort.

Ideal for Home, Office, and Gifting

Whether you are looking for a functional desk clock, a modern wall clock, or a premium gifting solution, the by Solaris meets all requirements. Its sleek build, smart features, and customizable models make it suitable for corporate gifts, festive occasions, and promotional branding.

Why Choose?

  • Modern wall and table clock in one device
  • High-visibility LED display with multiple data points
  • Energy-efficient USB-powered operation
  • Premium models with customization options
  • Perfect blend of décor and technology

Choose the to experience a smart, stylish, and reliable timekeeping solution designed for today’s lifestyle.
